Room.title: Room
Room.description: A shared project workspace room identified by an 8-character uppercase alphanumeric server-generated code.

title.description: Display title of the project room.

summary.description: Short snapshot summary of the project.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room creator.

agentAggressiveness.description: Proactive cadence setting for @cohort in this room.

agentStatus.description: Live operational status of @cohort in this room.

agentStatusAt.description: Server timestamp when @cohort status last changed.

lastProactiveAt.description: Server timestamp when @cohort last sent a proactive message.

lastPulseCheckAt.description: Server timestamp when @cohort pulse last evaluated this room.

nudgeState.description: Per-task proactive nudge backoff state keyed by task ID (max 40 entries).

Member.title: Member
Member.description: A Google-authenticated member belonging to a project room, keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

displayName.description: Member display name from Google sign-in.

photoURL.description: Optional profile photo URL from Google sign-in.

online.description: Whether the member is currently active in the room.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user joined.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of the last presence update.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A real-time chat message in a project room from a team member or @cohort assistant.

senderId.description: UID of the sender or 'cohort' for assistant messages.

triggeredBy.description: UID of the authenticated user who initiated the message or command.

role.description: Whether the message was sent by a user or @cohort.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: A project board task belonging to a room.

id.description: Task identifier such as t1, t2.

description.description: Optional concise acceptance criteria or implementation notes for the task.

task_type.description: Detected or classified discipline for the task.

owner_uid.description: Optional UID of assigned member or empty string.

due_date.description: Due date label, e.g. Nov 20 or 2026-11-20.

updatedBy.description: UID of the member who created or last updated the task.

LogEntry.title: LogEntry
LogEntry.description: Contribution and activity log entry recording task changes in a room.

actorId.description: UID of the acting user or 'cohort'.

triggeredBy.description: UID of the authenticated user responsible for the action.

action.description: Action verb such as completed, blocked, started, created, reassigned.

RateLimit.title: RateLimit
RateLimit.description: Per-user sliding-window rate limit counters for room creation and AI commands.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the rate-limited user.

roomWindowStart.description: Server timestamp when the current room-creation window started.

roomCount.description: Number of rooms created in the current window.

cohortWindowStart.description: Server timestamp when the current AI command window started.

cohortCount.description: Number of AI commands executed in the current window.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last counter update.

Invite.title: Invite
Invite.description: Temporary expiring invite link for a project room.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room owner who generated the invite.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the invite was created.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp after which the invite can no longer be used.

maxUses.description: Maximum number of joins allowed via this invite.

usedCount.description: Number of times the invite has been redeemed.

active.description: Whether the invite is active or has been revoked.

BlockedMember.title: BlockedMember
BlockedMember.description: Rejection cooldown record preventing an immediately rejected user from re-requesting room access before `until`.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the rejected user.

count.description: Cumulative rejection count used for exponential cooldown backoff.

until.description: Timestamp after which the user may submit a new join request.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest rejection.

RoomFile.title: RoomFile
RoomFile.description: Text project file belonging to a room, uploaded manually or imported from a Git repository.

path.description: Normalized relative file path within the project.

mimeType.description: MIME type inferred from file extension.

size.description: UTF-8 byte size of the file content.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member who created or imported the file.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member who last updated the file.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Project room metadata keyed by 8-character uppercase alphanumeric code.

/rooms/{roomCode}/members/{memberId}.description: Authenticated room members keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/rooms/{roomCode}/invites/{inviteId}.description: Temporary expiring invite links created by the room owner.

/rooms/{roomCode}/blocked/{blockedUid}.description: Per-user rejection cooldown records keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/rooms/{roomCode}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time team chat messages and @cohort assistant replies.

/rooms/{roomCode}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Kanban project board tasks for the room.

/rooms/{roomCode}/files/{fileId}.description: Shared text project files for the room (max 30 files, 200KB each).

/rooms/{roomCode}/logs/{logId}.description: Contribution log entries for task updates and board extractions.

/rateLimits/{userId}.description: Per-user rate-limit counters keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
